verdict.rationale: Finix's platform-payments docs show APIs for seller onboarding, payouts, and dashboard management that platforms can build on, plus 'Tokenization Forms' explicitly described as a checkout page 'you own and control' — evidence of white-label intent (finix-docs-9, finix-docs-10, finix-docs-12, finix-docs-30). However, evidence centers on onboarding/payout/checkout flows rather than a dedicated embeddable balance/transaction-history component, and the reporting/dashboard features (finix-docs-24) appear tied to Finix's own dashboard rather than confirmed as embeddable in a seller's branded product. Missing for 10: explicit prebuilt embeddable UI components (balances, transaction history) with branding/theming controls, and independent/hands-on confirmation of white-labeling in production.
